The roller and its handle stay fully inside the frame. The camera is completely static and the character stays in the same place in the frame the whole time, it does not move across or out of the frame. The background stays solid flat pure green (#00FF00) for the entire video, with no shadows, no floor and no other objects. Keep exactly the same hand-drawn doodle cartoon style, thick black outlines, colors and proportions as the image, no morphing of the face or goggles. Lively, bouncy, exaggerated cartoon motion with squash and stretch and secondary motion on the ears, whiskers and tail; something is always moving, never a still moment.
